metadata.name: Whats My DPS [Fixed]
metadata.description:
[h1] 我的DPS是多少？[修复版] [/h1] 修复版支持中英文，支持 Mod配置菜单 修改设置，建议订阅 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2494192799]Mod配置菜单（中文版）[/url] [h2]主要修复：[/h2] [b][list] [*] 修复修改设置后重启游戏设置失效。 [*] 新增中文支持。 [/list][/b]
项目Github地址：https://github.com/Lulozi/WhatsMyDPS
[h3]原作者模组：[/h3] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3093631959] What's My DPS? [/url] [h3]原模组Github地址：[/h3] https://github.com/SpikeHD/WhatsMyDPS
[hr][/hr] This fixed version supports both Chinese and English and allows settings to be adjusted via Mod Config Menu. For the best experience, we recommend subscribing to [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3701683951] Mod Config Menu - Impure [/url]. [h2]Main Fixes:[/h2] [b][list] [*] Fixed settings resetting to default after restarting the game. [*] Added Simplified Chinese support. [/list][/b]
Project GitHub: https://github.com/Lulozi/WhatsMyDPS
[h3]Original Mod:[/h3] [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3093631959]What's My DPS?[/url] [h3]Original Mod GitHub:[/h3] https://github.com/SpikeHD/WhatsMyDPS
